prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color texture for clean satin powder-coated spacecraft alloy, source image only.
Primary request: a full-frame, orthographic, high-resolution, photoreal industrial material scan of clean silver-white / very light cool gray precision polyester-ceramic thin coating on metal. The entire image is only the continuous coated surface, no object shape, no edges or borders. Sophisticated fresh aerospace product finish with only extremely fine, uniform, low-contrast micro orange-peel texture, almost smooth at normal viewing distance. The photographically credible microtexture should suggest a thin, dense, tightly controlled satin industrial coating. Intended world coverage about one meter; surface microdetail is substantially finer than millimeter scale.
Color palette: neutral cool silver-white light gray, uniform overall base color approximately sRGB #c8ccce, subtle tiny per-pixel variation only, no broad mottling.
Lighting: de-lit albedo / base color material scan, flat diffuse cross-polarized illumination, identical even brightness in all areas, no baked specular highlights, no shadows, no gradients or directional lighting.
Composition: square, perfectly front-facing orthographic flat material field, full bleed, seamless repeating edges, no visible tile seam. Keep all four corners the same average shade.
Avoid: black dots, pores, pits, holes, sand, grit, grains, concrete, cement, plaster, stone, dirt, scratches, wear, discoloration, stains, patina, cloudy blotches, cracks, visible brush strokes, large bumps, flecks, sparkles, glare, hotspots, vignettes, bevels, panel seams, borders, objects, typography, labels, logos, watermarks. This is a pristine smooth satin engineered coating, not a rough granular material.
